The judge highlighted 'Craftsmanship (no floating parts, z-fighting, holes)' as the weakest feature. A significant portion of this "crude" rating comes from those window stripes looking like they're floating on the surface and the engines having no clear structural connection to the wings.

I will now address the window placement to make them sit cleanly on the fuselage cylinder surface and simultaneously adjust the engine/pylon positions slightly so they appear more integrated with the wing structure. Since I can only do one edit, I'll focus on the windows as it affects many areas of the model's "solid assembly" look at once.
